title: DATA↔QA-001: Data-Quality Reports + Test Datasets
description: Data provides data-quality reports, test datasets, and pipeline validation hooks; QA returns data-pipeline test results and data-quality-gate verification. Grounded in DATA_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.7. (QA §6 has no Data Engineer subsection; this edge is grounded from the Data side.)

data_quality_package.description: DATA→QA: quality reports + test datasets + hooks.

qa_verification.description: QA→DATA: pipeline test results + quality-gate verdict.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine data-quality reporting and test-dataset exchange is agent-autonomous. A failed data-quality gate feeds the release-gate sign-off (QA go/no-go).
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (quality-gate definition at planning; validation during execution; release-gate sign-off)
confirm_conditions: data_quality_report carries completeness_pct and validity_pct (with % units)
≥1 test_dataset supplied with a declared purpose
qa_verification returns a pipeline_test_result and a quality_gate_verdict
reject_conditions: quality_gate_verdict = PASS while validity_pct or completeness_pct is below the agreed gate (Honesty Over Polish, §10.3)
test datasets withheld where a quality gate requires them
counter_conditions: quality metric marginal / within noise — request a larger sample before the verdict
test dataset not representative of field distribution — request a field-sampled dataset
